instruction: Generate a PDF from the "Meeting-Agenda.docx" file on the Desktop and upload the resulting PDF to my Google Drive meetings folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting Meeting-Agenda.docx to PDF and uploading to Google Drive. Evaluator verifies the file is a valid PDF format with at least 1 page.
metadata.verification: Verified that the meeting agenda document is single-page and should convert to a valid PDF format with 1 page.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: PDF generation and upload to Google Drive meetings folder
Getter (get_googledrive_file) successfully extracts the uploaded file from Google Drive path 'meetings/Meeting-Agenda.pdf' and downloads it locally
Metric (check_pdf_format__988ec512) correctly validates: (1) file exists, (2) file is valid PDF format via PdfReader, (3) PDF has at least 1 page
Expected value semantically correct: checks for valid PDF with min_pages=1, which confirms successful conversion and upload
Complete coverage: presence of valid PDF at target location proves both conversion from .docx and upload were successful
Edge cases properly handled: non-existent file, invalid PDF format, empty PDF all return 0.0
No postconfig needed: file state on Google Drive is persistent and accessible
Logic flow is sound: download from Drive -> validate format -> verify page count

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_pdf_format__988ec512 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_googledrive_file return type (Any)
